reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the audio experience in Provincia. The day, night, title, and combat music beds now transition smoothly without hard cuts. Our new long equal-power crossfade technique ensures a seamless listening experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

posts: Exciting news for Provincia players! Our audio system has been upgraded to eliminate abrupt music changes. Enjoy a more immersive experience with smooth transitions between different music beds. Read more about it here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

We're thrilled to announce that the music in Provincia now features seamless transitions! No more jarring cuts between day and night music. Discover how we achieved this improvement: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
